notes:
## New features & enhancements

- The "Add station" key fits its label better. If the words are only a little too wide for the key they are made slightly smaller; if they are much too wide they go onto two lines, "Add" over "station", so the key stays the same height as the ones beside it.
- A station's name on a preset key starts scrolling a little sooner when you hover over it.
- Enhancements to seasonal themes.

## Bug fixes

- Fixes in seasonal themes.
